executionValidation: Every CSS code_input must use recipeType source_checks
Every CSS code_input must include at least one sourceChecks rule
Use source_regex or source_contains checks against styles.css and only inspect HTML when the styling task requires a selector-to-markup relationship
Do not create stdout tests for CSS-only exercises
pedagogy: Keep CSS Foundations focused on styling, layout, responsive design, maintainability, and accessible visual states
Each hands-on exercise should create a visible result in the browser preview
Provide semantic HTML starters so learners practice CSS instead of re-authoring prerequisite HTML
Do not require JavaScript or CSS frameworks to complete CSS Foundations
